{{Quote|I greet you, Lady Vader. But I do not welcome you.|Clan Kihm'bar's ''maitrakh'' to Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Honoghr''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. During the mission, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] managed to convince the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] to join the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Prelude==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] ordered the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] to [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Thrawn campaign)|kidnap]] the pregnant [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. All Noghri except [[Khabarakh]] of [[Clan Kihm'bar]] were killed. The Noghri eventually identified Leia as the ''[[Mal'ary'ush]]'', the ''daughter of the savior'': [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==The Mission==
Realizing that neither she nor her children would be truly safe as long as the Noghri served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and that her position of ''Mal'ary'ush'' could be an advantage, Leia Organa went to [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] with Khabarakh in order to convince the Noghri to leave the Empire's service.

[[File:Honoghrthrone.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Grand Admiral Thrawn returned to Honoghr to remind the Noghri of their duty to the Empire.]]

She first met the [[Unidentified maitrakh|''maitrakh'']] of [[Clan Kihm'bar]] who accepted to support her. The ''[[maitrakh]]'' hid her when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] landed on Honoghr looking for Khabarakh, with doubts about his loyalty to the Empire.

After Thrawn's departure, the ''maitrakh'' accepted to reunite the council of [[dynast]]s in [[Nystao]] in order to talk with Leia. She was able to use the fact that she was the daughter of Darth Vader to convince some Noghri that the Empire had been lying to them and kept them in virtual slavery for many years. But by proving that the Imperial [[Decon III|Decon droids]] and the [[Kholm-grass|''kholm''-grass]] seeded by the Empire were responsible of the degradation of Honoghr, all the dynasts understood that they were betrayed by the Empire.

[[File:Malaryush-TLC3.jpg|thumb|200px|Leia Organa Solo as the ''Mal'ary'ush'.]]

==Aftermath==
As a result, the Noghri [[Noghri revolution|turned against the Empire]] and joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Grand Admiral Thrawn died when his Noghri bodyguard [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]] turned on him and stabbed him at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].

Leia and her entire family also became very highly respected figures in Noghri society. The New Republic helped resettle the Noghri to other planets, including [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], to give Honoghr time to heal.
